comment: Policy for src/gate.mjs (the pre-sign gate). Rules 1-2 use maxAnchorAgeH and maxDailyUsd. Rule 3 (counterparty) uses the four lists. Every entry says where it came from. Addresses are public contracts or APIs, never a person's wallet. A change to this file is a policy change: it is public in git history before any send relies on it.
